title: AI-POWERED BUSINESS GENERALIST | OPERATIONS, GROWTH & AUTOMATION
description:
AI-POWERED BUSINESS GENERALIST | OPERATIONS, GROWTH & AUTOMATION

Remote | Long-term | Full commitment | €
/ week| Philippines



IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT A STANDARD VA ROLE



We are looking for someone smart, ambitious and extremely eager to learn.



Not someone who needs a perfectly defined task list.

Not someone who wants to stay inside one area of expertise.

And not someone whose main question is: "What are my working hours?"



We are looking for someone who wants to understand how a business works, use AI to learn extremely quickly, improve the way work gets done and gradually take on more responsibility.



Your exact role will partly depend on what you are good at.



You might develop more towards:



* AI, processes and automation

* Growth marketing and analytics

* Video editing and creative work

* Business operations

* Or a combination of these



We are deliberately keeping that open.



What matters much more is HOW YOU THINK, HOW FAST YOU LEARN AND HOW MUCH OWNERSHIP YOU TAKE.



ABOUT VLYOU



VLYOU helps companies improve and run their operations.



We work on processes, operational execution, service delivery, AI, automation, marketing and business improvement.



We are a small international team with ambitious plans.



Our seven core values are:



COLLABORATION

We work as a team. We help each other, share information and make sure customers are never dependent on one individual.



CURIOSITY

We don't just want to know WHAT to do. We want to understand WHY.



CREATIVITY

If the obvious solution doesn't work, we look for another one.



HONESTY

Mistakes can happen. Hiding them is much worse. We need people who speak up.



OWNERSHIP

Do what you say and say what you do. Stay one step ahead and take responsibility for the outcome.



WORLD-CLASS PERFORMANCE

We continuously look for ways to improve quality, standardize work, reduce errors and work smarter.



PASSION

We want people who bring energy to their work and genuinely want to achieve something.



WHAT WILL YOU ACTUALLY DO?



There is no perfect answer yet.



And that is intentional.



We are hiring the PERSON first and will partly shape the role around your strengths, interests and development.



At the start, you will spend part of your time working with our CargoCare team, a Dutch freight forwarding company.



You do NOT need freight forwarding experience.



CargoCare is partly your operational onboarding into how we work as a team: ownership, communication, quality, SOPs, deadlines, customer service and continuous improvement.



At the same time, you will already start supporting other activities.



Depending on your skills, this could include things such as:



* Using Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools to research and solve business problems

* Improving processes and creating SOPs

* Identifying work that can be standardized or automated

* Building AI workflows and automations

* Working with Claude Code or similar tools

* Analyzing data and business performance

* Google Ads / Meta Ads

* GA4 and marketing analysis

* Growth marketing

* SEO or Search Console

*
 marketing

* Website improvements

* Video editing

* Creating visuals and marketing materials

* Social media content

* Supporting client projects

* Operational or administrative work when needed



We do NOT expect you to already be great at everything on this list.



That would be unrealistic.



We do expect you to be the type of person who can be given an unfamiliar problem and think:



"Okay. I don't know this yet. How do I figure it out?"



Then use AI, research, questions and critical thinking to get there quickly.



THE PERSON WE ARE REALLY LOOKING FOR



If we had to choose between:



A) Someone with five years of experience who knows exactly how they have always done their job



and



B) Someone with less experience who is extremely smart, curious, energetic, analytical and learns incredibly quickly



We would choose B.



Without hesitation.



You may only have 1-2 years of professional experience.



That's fine.



We don't require a university degree either.



Your potential matters much more to us.



The most important qualities for this role are:



1. INTELLIGENCE & ANALYTICAL THINKING

   You understand complex information quickly, recognize patterns and can break problems into logical pieces.



2. LEARNING AGILITY

   You can enter a subject you know little about and become useful surprisingly quickly.



3. DRIVE / ENERGY / PASSION

   You don't sit around waiting for someone to create work for you. You want to move things forward.



4. PROACTIVITY

   You ask questions, investigate problems, identify opportunities and keep people informed.



5. COMMUNICATION

   You communicate clearly and confidently in English and are not afraid to ask a clarifying question when something is unclear.



6. PROCESS THINKING

   You don't want to solve the same problem manually 50 times. You ask whether it can be standardized, documented, improved or automated.



7. RELIABILITY

   People should know where they stand with you. If something may go wrong or a deadline is at risk, you communicate BEFORE it becomes a problem.



AI EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You do not need to be an AI engineer.



But if it is 2026 and you have barely used tools like ChatGPT or Claude, this role is probably not a good fit.



AI is an important part of how we work.



We expect you to have practical experience with prompting and to understand that good AI use is much more than asking one question and copying the answer.



You should be comfortable with things such as:



* Iterating until an AI output is actually useful

* Asking follow-up questions

* Providing proper context

* Critically checking AI answers

* Using AI to research unfamiliar subjects

* Identifying which questions need to be answered

* Comparing multiple possible solutions

* Using AI to challenge your own thinking

* Recognizing repetitive work that could be automated

* Building reusable workflows instead of starting from zero every time



Experience with Claude Code, automation, no-code tools, APIs, programming or SOP/process design is a strong PLUS.



So is experience in digital marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, video editing or design.



But those are NOT hard requirements.



WORKING WITH ME / OUR CULTURE



This part is important.



We offer a lot of freedom.



We also have high expectations.



You should expect regular feedback and sometimes very direct feedback.



That doesn't mean we want a negative working environment.



Quite the opposite.



I personally invest time in helping team members improve, understand why something could be better and develop new skills.



If you respond well to that, you can have a very steep development curve here.



But this environment is not for everyone.



If critical feedback makes you withdraw, stop communicating or hide problems, you probably won't enjoy working with us.



If your response is:



"Okay, I understand. How do I make it better?"



you probably will.



You also need to be comfortable saying:



"I don't fully understand the assignment yet."



or:



"I understand what you're asking, but I think there may be a better way to achieve the goal."



We don't need blind obedience.



We need people who think.



SELF-STARTER DOES NOT MEAN WORKING IN SILENCE



We want independence, but we don't expect you to read minds.



Many of our projects are new. Sometimes there is no SOP yet.



When an assignment is unclear, ASK.



When you are making an important decision, KEEP THE RELEVANT PEOPLE INFORMED.



When a deadline is at risk, SAY SO EARLY.



When you see a problem, DON'T HOPE IT DISAPPEARS.



Once objectives and expectations are clear, we want you to work independently.



The amount of coordination should depend on the risk and uncertainty involved.



WORKING HOURS & COMMITMENT



OnlineJobs requires us to define working hours, so officially this is approximately a 40-hour-per-week position.



But we do NOT want a shift mentality.



We don't care whether one particular Tuesday contains exactly 8.00 hours of work.



We do care whether:



* Your responsibilities are covered

* Your work gets done

* Quality meets expectations

* Deadlines are managed

* Your colleagues can depend on you

* You are available when coordination is needed



There is significant flexibility in when you work.



We require at least approximately 4 hours of regular overlap with Netherlands time between 09:00 and 22:00.



Some assignments, such as operational work at CargoCare, naturally require more specific availability.



Flexibility works both ways.



If you need to move a few hours around, that is usually fine.



Likewise, if something occasionally needs a little extra effort to deliver what was agreed, we expect ownership instead of clock-watching.



We are looking for FULL COMMITMENT.



This means no ongoing second job, freelance workload or study that competes with this role long term.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



Starting rate: €4-6/hour depending on experience, skills and potential.



Payment is weekly.



Your first two weeks are a PAID ONBOARDING & ACCELERATION PERIOD.



This is not designed as an elimination round where we expect half the people to leave.



We use this period to:



* Learn where your strengths are

* See how you learn

* Determine where you can add the most value

* Give you the opportunity to prove yourself immediately



Exceptional performance can result in an immediate salary increase.



After that, there are regular opportunities to grow in both responsibility and compensation.



We also offer:



* Performance-based salary growth

* Quarterly team bonus opportunities

* Additional bonuses when appropriate

* Increasing flexibility as trust grows

* Paid vacation and sick leave after you have established yourself with the team



If you perform well, there is a lot of upside.



HARD REQUIREMENTS



Please read these carefully.



1. ONLINEJOBS IQ SCORE: 120+

   You must have completed the OnlineJobs IQ test and score at least 120.



No test = rejection.

Below 120 = rejection.



2. ENGLISH: MINIMUM C1 ON YOUR ONLINEJOBS PROFILE

   In practice, we expect near-C2 communication.



You must be able to understand complex questions, communicate nuances and have a natural conversation in English.



If something is unclear, we expect you to ASK rather than guess.



3. PRACTICAL AI EXPERIENCE

   You need actual experience using tools such as ChatGPT or Claude and understand basic prompting.



4. FULL COMMITMENT

   You must be able to make this your main professional commitment.



5. FOLLOW THE APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

   We receive many applications.



If you don't meet a hard requirement or ignore the application instructions, your application may be rejected without a response.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word:



LEVERAGE



Then answer ALL questions below in numbered format.



Please don't give us generic answers about being "hardworking, passionate and a fast learner."



SHOW US.



1. YOUR BACKGROUND



Briefly introduce yourself.



Include:



* Your age

* Your current work situation

* Your most relevant previous roles

* What type of work you believe you are unusually good at

* Your expected hourly rate in EUR

* When you could start



Also confirm that you can make this role your main professional commitment.



2. AI



Which AI tools do you currently use and what do you actually use them for?



Give ONE specific example of a task where you used AI in a way that materially improved the quality or speed of your work.



Explain what YOU did rather than only describing what the AI produced.



3. LEARNING



Describe one situation where you had to learn something difficult that you initially knew very little about.



What did you need to learn?



How did you approach it?



Which resources or people did you use?



What did you do when something wasn't clear?



How quickly were you able to become useful?



4. IMPROVEMENT



Give one concrete example where you thought:



"There has to be a better way to do this."



It can involve a process, spreadsheet, repetitive task, marketing activity, communication flow, administration or anything else.



What was happening?



What did you change or propose?



What was the result?



5. FEEDBACK



Describe a situation where someone gave you feedback that you initially disagreed with or found difficult.



What was the feedback?



How did you respond?



Did you change anything afterwards?



6. CHOOSE ONE



Which direction currently interests you MOST?



A. AI / AUTOMATION / PROCESSES

B. GROWTH MARKETING / ANALYTICS

C. DESIGN / VIDEO / CREATIVE

D. OPERATIONS / BUSINESS SUPPORT

E. I genuinely don't know yet and enjoy combining different areas



Explain WHY in no more than 100 words.



There is no preferred answer.



Your answer helps us understand where your natural interests are.



IMPORTANT



You are allowed to use AI when preparing your application.



In fact, we'd be surprised if you didn't.



But remember:



AI can make a weak answer sound polished.



It cannot turn a weak example into a strong one.



We are much more interested in your actual thinking, choices and experiences than in perfect wording.



Candidates who pass this first screening will go through a few written rounds, followed by a practical AI/analytical assessment and an interview.



We're looking for someone we can invest in for the long term.



If you are extremely curious, learn fast, enjoy being challenged and want a role that can grow significantly with you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Logistics Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



This role sits inside a global logistics technology company that helps e-commerce brands streamline international fulfillment. As Logistics Operations Manager, you own the daily playbooks that keep freight moving on schedule and inventory accurate, coordinating with freight brokers, reconciling inventory on receipt, ensuring timely warehouse inbounding, and applying sound judgment on the roughly 10% of daily operations that fall outside standard procedure. You are embedded directly with a growth-stage business and leadership team who need a technically strong, independent operator, with ongoing coaching, clear standards, and a dedicated Success Manager behind you so you can focus on doing excellent work.

This is a dedicated, full-time role designed for meaningful impact, stability, and professional growth in logistics and cross-border operations.



Responsibilities

• Execute daily logistics operations playbooks, applying independent judgment on the estimated 10% of cases that fall outside standard procedure

• Source and compare freight brokerage quotes, balancing delivery timelines against cost to secure the best option for each shipment

• Coordinate directly with freight brokers to confirm bookings, track shipments in transit, and resolve delays

• Reconcile inventory upon receipt, verifying quantities and condition against purchase orders and manifests

• Ensure timely warehouse inbounding, coordinating with warehouse teams to prevent processing bottlenecks

• Review commercial invoices for accuracy on cross-border shipments before they move forward

• Apply working knowledge of HS codes to classify shipments correctly and avoid customs delays

• Maintain accurate records in internal operations tools and calculators used for daily decision-making

• Flag discrepancies, delays, or exceptions to the appropriate internal team promptly and clearly

• Support ad hoc logistics projects and process improvements as the business scales

• Adapt quickly as priorities shift, maintaining dependable throughput across all daily operational tasks





Qualifications

• Background in logistics, freight, or e-commerce operations (must-have)

• Working understanding of HS codes and customs classification (must-have)

• Familiarity with commercial invoices and cross-border shipping documentation (must-have)

• Ability to run daily operational playbooks independently, exercising judgment where needed (must-have)

• Strong attention to detail and consistent, dependable daily throughput (must-have)

• Comfortable coordinating directly with freight brokers and vendors (must-have)

• Experience with inventory reconciliation processes preferred

• Experience with internal ops software, calculators, or WMS platforms preferred





Tools You'll Use

• Freight and Logistics: freight brokerage coordination and quoting systems (must-have)

• Trade Documentation: HS code references and commercial invoice systems (must-have)

• Inventory: warehouse and inventory reconciliation tools (must-have)

• Internal Systems: company operations tools and calculators (must-have), plus WMS platforms where available





Benefits

• Competitive salary

• Paid US holidays

• Paid wellness days

• Health and wellness allowance

• Monthly profit sharing

• Long-term placement with real growth

• Continuous upskilling in AI and logistics operations

• Dedicated success coaching and support





REQUIREMENTS

Background in logistics, freight, OR e-commerce operations

Experience with commercial invoices and cross-border shipping documentation

Experience with inventory reconciliation against POs and manifests

E-commerce and global shipping experience

EP Solutions is a growing real estate wholesaling company based in Ohio. We are a small, fast-moving team focused on finding and acquiring off-market properties — and we're looking for someone who can help us turn conversations into real opportunities.



This is more than just an SMS position.

We believe in working smarter, not just sending more messages. If a seller is engaged, we want to have a real conversation and move the opportunity forward. 



THE ROLE

As our SMS & Lead Engagement Specialist, you'll be one of the first points of contact between EP Solutions and property owners.



You'll be responsible for:



Managing and monitoring SMS campaigns through Smarter Contact

Responding to incoming messages in a professional, natural, and conversational way

description:
# Experienced Dropshipping VA Partner – Multi-Platform E-Commerce



I am looking for **highly experienced Virtual Assistants to partner with me in building dropshipping businesses across multiple third-party e-commerce platforms.**



**This is NOT a beginner position.**



I am specifically looking for people who have **already successfully operated dropshipping on platforms other than Shopify, Walmart, eBay, and Amazon.**



### Platforms



I am open to different platforms, but you **must already have hands-on experience dropshipping on the specific platform you propose.**



If you have experience on platforms such as marketplaces, niche marketplaces, social commerce platforms, or other third-party e-commerce sites, tell me exactly which ones.



**Do not apply if your experience is only with Shopify, Walmart, eBay, or Amazon.**



### What You Must Be Able to Handle



I am looking for someone who can manage the **entire dropshipping operation from A to Z**, including:



* Finding and researching profitable products

* Product sourcing and supplier research

* Evaluating suppliers

* Creating and optimizing listings

* Uploading products

* Pricing and repricing

* Managing inventory

* Processing customer orders

* Purchasing products from suppliers

* Order fulfillment

* Tracking number collection and uploading

* Handling order issues

* Customer service

* Returns/refunds when applicable

* Monitoring account health

* Managing day-to-day operations

* Following platform policies and avoiding account violations

* Maintaining spreadsheets/reports when needed



### 2-Step Dropshipping



**2-step dropshipping is also an option.**



If you have experience with a 2-step model where inventory/orders move through an intermediate location, warehouse, prep center, or fulfillment partner before reaching the customer, explain exactly how you operated it.



### PROOF OF EXPERIENCE IS VERY IMPORTANT



I do **not** want generic applications saying:



> "I have 5 years of dropshipping experience."



I want you to **prove your experience.**



When applying, provide as much evidence as possible, such as:



* Resume/CV

* Screenshots of seller dashboards

* Screenshots of listings you created

* Screenshots showing sales/orders

* Screenshots of platform metrics

* Screenshots of product catalogs

* Screenshots of supplier relationships/processes

* Examples of stores you personally managed

* Description of your exact responsibilities

* Platforms you have personally operated

* How many products you managed

* Approximate monthly sales/volume you handled

* How you handled fulfillment

* How you sourced products

* How you handled tracking

* How long you operated the store



**You may blur or remove sensitive information, customer information, store names, account numbers, or other confidential information from screenshots.**



### APPLICATION REQUIREMENT



Your application MUST answer the following:



**1. Which third-party platforms have you personally dropshipped on?**



**2. Which platform was your most successful experience on?**



**3. Explain your complete dropshipping process from finding the product ? listing ? receiving an order ? purchasing ? fulfillment ? tracking ? customer delivery.**



**4. Were you responsible for the entire operation, or only certain tasks?**



**5. Did you personally handle product listings? Explain.**



**6. Did you personally handle fulfillment and tracking? Explain.**



**7. Did you use 1-step dropshipping, 2-step dropshipping, or both? Explain exactly how it worked.**



**8. What suppliers did you use?**



**9. Approximately how many products/orders did you manage?**



**10. What proof of your experience can you provide?**



### IMPORTANT



I am looking for someone who can **actually operate the business**, not someone who needs to be taught the fundamentals of dropshipping.



If you have successfully built or managed a dropshipping operation on a platform outside of Shopify, Walmart, eBay, and Amazon, **I want to hear exactly what you did and see proof of it.**



The **more detailed and verifiable your application is, the better.**



Please include your **resume and supporting screenshots/proof of experience** with your application.



**Generic applications will be ignored.**



ALSO PROVIDE YOUR WHATSAPP NUMBER

title: AI Video Creator (Google Flow) — Long-Term, All Tools Paid
description:
Hi,

I run a fast-growing health and wellness page on
 and Instagram built around an AI avatar, plus a network of additional pages. The videos are fully AI-generated. I write the scripts — you turn them into finished videos.

I am looking for one or two experienced AI video creators to join long-term.



WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

You receive a plain text script from me and handle everything from there — image generation, video generation, and the final edit — and deliver a minimum of 6 finished videos per day, ready to post.

To be clear: this is NOT an editing job, and it is NOT a training role. I am not looking for someone to cut footage I hand them, and I am not going to teach you the tools from scratch. I need someone who already produces at a high level from day one — generating, judging whether an output is good enough, re-generating when it isn't, and assembling the final video in CapCut.

I will give you my scripts, my reference videos and my style rules. You should be producing on day one with minimal direction. The process is fast and repeatable once you know the style.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

Proven hands-on experience with Google Flow / Veo 3 — generating photorealistic AI video from written prompts, clean vertical short-form, ready to post. Not "I use ChatGPT." I mean real work you can show me. Please include examples of your work.

GPT Images and Nano Banana (1, 2 and Pro) — hyper-realistic AI image generation, and knowing when to use which. Character appearance, clothing and setting must stay consistent across every generation in a video.

ElevenLabs for voiceover, timed so there is no dead air and no cut-off lines.



CapCut — text overlays, font styling, music syncing, color grading and precise pacing. You can look at a reference video and replicate the editing style exactly, without being told every detail.

An eye for when a generation is unusable — distorted hands, unnatural movement, a face that changes between clips. You catch it and re-run it. You do not send it to me because it was your fourth attempt.

Strong written and spoken English.



High output. 3-6 videos a day, 5–6 days a week, consistently — not 9 one day and 2 the next.

Some creative range. Most days you follow the style exactly. Occasionally I will send a script with image and video inspiration attached and ask you to build a new style from it.

Stable internet and a computer that can handle video work.



WHAT I PROVIDE

I pay for google flow and every tool you will use. You will not spend a single peso on anything. Your only job is to create videos.

Access to the accounts you need to work.

All the scripts. You do not have to come up with ideas.

My reference videos and style rules, so you know exactly what "good" looks like.

Serious, friendly working environment. I respond fast and I expect the same.

PAY

$3.00 to $3.30 per approved video, depending on your level.

Bonuses for videos that go viral.

One reasonable round of revisions is included in that rate. If a video has to be redone because my instructions were not followed, that is not a separate paid job.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word TURMERIC so I know you read the entire post.

Send links to AI videos YOU created yourself. This matters far more to me than your resume.

Tell me exactly which AI video, image and voice tools you have used, and for how long.

Tell me about one difficult AI generation problem you ran into and how you solved it.

Tell me your availability — hours per day and days per week.

If you are comfortable with it, record a 30-second Loom video introducing yourself in English. This is optional, but it will move you to the top of my list.

Applications that skip these steps will not be read. Shortlisted applicants will get a small paid test video.

Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Mid-Level Freight Forwarding Operations Specialist
description:
MID-LEVEL FREIGHT FORWARDING OPERATIONS SPECIALIST



Remote | Full-time commitment | €120 – 200/week| Long-term



ABOUT VLYOU & CARGOCARE



VLYOU helps companies run and improve their operations through strong processes, clear standards, quality control, AI and continuous improvement.



For this role, you will primarily work in the team supporting CargoCare NL, a Dutch freight forwarder. You don't need to know their exact processes yet — we will teach you those.



What we do need is someone who already understands the freight forwarding world, learns quickly, takes ownership and wants to become very good at what they do.



THE ROLE



We're looking for a mid-level freight forwarding professional.



You do not need to be an expert. In fact, we expect there will be plenty for you to learn.



But you should already understand how a freight forwarder works: shipments, documents, carriers, agents, customers, deadlines, exceptions and the importance of keeping information accurate and up to date.



You will learn our specific processes, systems and SOPs on the job.



Typical activities may include:



* Creating and maintaining shipment files

* Monitoring ETD/ETA and shipment milestones

* Processing booking information and amendments

* Checking and coordinating shipping documents

* Following up with carriers, agents, customers and other stakeholders

* Track & trace and proactive status updates

* Identifying missing information or discrepancies

* Handling operational exceptions and escalating when needed

* Working according to SOPs, checklists and quality controls

* Helping us improve and standardize processes over time



Everything specific to our way of working can be learned. Your ability and motivation to learn quickly matter more than already knowing every task.



HARD REQUIREMENT: FREIGHT FORWARDING EXPERIENCE



You must have at least 1 year of actual work experience at a freight forwarding company, and this experience must have been gained within the last 3 years.



The mode does not matter. Sea freight, air freight, road freight, import or export can all be relevant.



However, experience only at a shipping line, airline, trucking company, carrier or shipper/manufacturer does NOT meet this requirement.



We specifically need someone who has already worked in the role/environment of a freight forwarder / forwarding agent.



If you do not meet this requirement, please do not apply. Applications that don't meet this hard requirement will be rejected without further response.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Experience gets you through the first door. Your mindset determines whether you will be successful.



We're especially interested in people who are:



* Smart and analytical — you understand things quickly and don't just follow instructions blindly

* Fast learners — you enjoy learning new systems, processes and subjects

* Motivated — you want to become better instead of simply completing today's task

* Proactive — when something is unclear, you ask; when something looks wrong, you investigate

* Reliable — you manage deadlines and communicate early if something is at risk

* Strong communicators — both written and spoken English need to be excellent

* Comfortable with feedback — expectations are high and feedback can be direct

* Quality-focused — accuracy matters in freight forwarding



Experience with process improvement, SOPs, standardization or automation is a plus, but not required.



Experience with Dutch/European freight forwarding, Rotterdam logistics or systems such as Scope/Riege or CargoWise is also a plus, not a requirement.



We also like people who are interested in learning beyond their immediate job. Over time, there may be opportunities to help with other processes, clients, automation or AI-related work if that fits your interests and abilities.



OUR WORKING CULTURE



We offer a lot of freedom, but freedom comes with ownership.



We don't want to build a culture around "when does my shift start and when can I clock out?"



CargoCare's operation needs to be covered by the team during its normal opening hours, approximately 08:00–17:00 Netherlands time, so most operational work will happen during those hours.



There is flexibility in how the team organizes this. What matters is that:



* Customers and colleagues can rely on us

* The operation is properly covered

* Deadlines are met

* You communicate when something needs attention

* You take responsibility for your work



We also have high expectations.



You should expect regular and sometimes direct feedback. That is not intended to make work unpleasant — quite the opposite. We invest time in helping people develop, because we want both the individual and the team to keep improving.



If you like being challenged, learning quickly and becoming better at your work, you can grow fast here.



If criticism makes you withdraw, hide mistakes or avoid difficult conversations, this probably isn't the right environment for you.



Mistakes can happen. Hiding them is much worse.



ENGLISH & COGNITIVE REQUIREMENTS



Because almost all communication takes place remotely and misunderstandings can quickly create operational problems:



* Your OnlineJobs English level must be at least C1

* In practice, we expect your spoken and written English to be close to C2

* Your OnlineJobs IQ test score must be 120 or higher



No IQ test, IQ below 120, or English below C1 = automatic rejection without further response.



These filters are strict because we receive many applications and want to focus our time on candidates who match the basic requirements.

title: B2B List Builder / Contact Enrichment Specialist — Veritas Management Group
description:
Location: Remote, any time zone Type: Project-based, paid per verified record. Strong performers get ongoing monthly work. Reports to: Guilherme Albergaria, CFO Start: Immediately. First deliverable is due 48 hours after award.



Who we are



Veritas Management Group is an outsourced finance department for owner-led companies in the $5M to $50M range, concentrated in manufacturing, construction, and professional services. We are launching an outbound calling program, and a calling program is only as good as its list. That's where you come in.



The project



We need call-ready contact records of US business OWNERS — verified mobile numbers, not company switchboards. The work has two parts:



Part 1 — Enrichment (starts immediately). We give you a CSV of 981 contacts with names, titles, companies, and LinkedIn profile URLs. For each one, you find and verify: mobile number and/or direct dial, business
, company city/state, and employee count. The LinkedIn URL is your match key — the data must belong to that exact person at that company. The file is pre-sorted by priority; you work it in priority order.



Part 2 — Net-new build (~500 records). Owners of manufacturing companies (10–100 employees) and law firms (2–15 attorneys) in Oklahoma, Texas, Arkansas, Kansas, and Missouri. You build from primary sources — state bar directories, state manufacturer registries and MEP directories, ThomasNet, firm websites, Google Maps — not from resold databases.



A full specification document (deliverable columns, verification standard, niche definitions) is attached to this posting.



What "verified" means here



You get paid per verified record, and we define verified precisely:



The phone number passes a line-validation check (Twilio Lookup, Numverify, or equivalent) as active, with the line type identified.

The number belongs to the named person. (For law firms under ~5 attorneys only, the firm's published main line is acceptable, marked as "main line.")

Name, title, and company match the LinkedIn profile or source directory as of the delivery date.



We spot-check a random 10% of every batch by actually dialing. If more than 10% of the sample is disconnected, wrong-person, or mismatched, the batch goes back for correction before payment. This is not a gotcha — it's so the people who do careful work get paid promptly and repeatedly.



What we will not accept

Pre-made, brokered, or resold lists of any kind

Bulk scrapes without per-record verification

Company main lines passed off as direct numbers (outside the small-law-firm exception)

Records outside the specified states, company sizes, or owner-level titles



If your plan is to export a database query and rename the columns, this is not your project.

title: Personal Injury Lien Negotiator
description:
We are a busy chiropractic office seeking an experienced, professional, and highly organized Personal Injury Lien Negotiator to join our team.

The ideal candidate has experience working with personal injury cases, medical liens, attorneys, law firms, insurance-related documentation, and patient accounts. This position requires someone who can confidently negotiate lien reductions while protecting the financial interests of our practice and maintaining strong, professional relationships with attorneys, case managers, patients, and other parties involved in personal injury claims.

Because this position involves access to protected health information, the successful candidate must have a strong understanding of HIPAA requirements and maintain strict patient confidentiality at all times.

Key Responsibilities

Negotiate chiropractic and medical liens related to personal injury cases

Review settlement information, lien reduction requests, balances, payments, and supporting documentation

Evaluate proposed lien reductions and negotiate appropriate payment amounts

Communicate professionally with attorneys, paralegals, case managers, patients, and other parties

Build and maintain positive, long-term relationships with personal injury law firms and referral partners

Follow up consistently on outstanding personal injury accounts and liens

Track negotiations, correspondence, settlement status, payments, and account activity

Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of all communications and agreements

Coordinate with office management and billing staff regarding outstanding balances and negotiated settlements

Handle sensitive patient and case information in accordance with HIPAA privacy and security requirements

Assist in resolving account discrepancies and obtaining necessary settlement or payment information

Maintain a professional approach while balancing successful collections with valuable attorney and referral relationships

Qualifications

Previous experience with personal injury lien negotiation, medical lien negotiation, chiropractic billing, personal injury collections, or a related field

Familiarity with personal injury cases and attorney lien-reduction requests

Knowledge of HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality requirements

Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Ability to develop and maintain professional relationships with attorneys and law firms

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

Comfortable managing multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-ups simultaneously

Professional, persistent, and diplomatic communication style

Experience with chiropractic or medical office systems and electronic records is a plus

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who understands that successful lien negotiation is about more than collecting a balance. The right candidate knows how to protect the value of the services provided by our office while preserving strong relationships with attorneys and referral partners.

You should be confident negotiating reductions, comfortable discussing account balances and settlements, diligent with follow-up, and capable of handling confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

To Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your experience with personal injury liens, lien reductions, attorney negotiations, chiropractic or medical billing, and HIPAA-compliant patient information.

We are looking for a dependable professional who can take ownership of our personal injury lien accounts and help strengthen the relationships that are important to our practice.

title: Virtual Admin & Sales Administrator
description:
About hubMed Telehealth

hubMed Telehealth is an Australian telehealth provider offering expert medical care from home. We support patients across Australia with 11 clinical services including mental health, ADHD, weight loss, women's health, chronic disease management, and more. We operate 7 days a week and our mission is to make quality healthcare accessible to every Australian, wherever they are.

We are a small, close-knit team that genuinely cares about our patients. This is not a call-centre role — you will be a valued member of the hubMed team, working directly with our clinical, operations, and business development staff.

The Role

This is a hybrid role split across two distinct functions. For part of your week, you'll be patient-facing — handling bookings, enquiries, and practice admin as part of our Virtual Admin & Customer Service function. For the rest, you'll shift into sales pipeline administration and broader practice operations support — CRM management, templated outreach, business insights, and provider schedule oversight.

It suits someone who can move between warm, careful patient communication and structured, detail-heavy admin work without either one slipping.

Position Virtual Admin & Sales Administrator

Type Full-time contractor

Hours 40 hours/week — Wednesday - Sunday [confirm split: recommend 2 days patient admin, 3 days sales/ops]

Schedule [Open — see note below on weekend patient coverage]

Pay rate PHP 45,000–65,000/month depending on experience · paid fortnightly via Wise/direct transfer

Location Fully remote — work from home

Reports to Practice Manager/Operations (patient admin) and Managing Director (sales/pipeline)



A note on scheduling: your current Virtual Admin & Customer Service Coordinator role runs Wednesday–Sunday to cover weekend patient demand. This hybrid role only allocates 2 of those 5 days to patient-facing work — worth confirming before this goes live whether another team member covers the remaining weekend/patient-facing days, or whether this role's patient-facing days should be chosen specifically to plug the biggest coverage gap.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Admin & Customer Service (~2 days/week)

● Respond to patient enquiries via
, phone, and live chat in a timely, professional, and empathetic manner.

● Assist patients with booking, rescheduling, and cancelling appointments via Halaxy.

● Follow up with patients who have incomplete bookings or outstanding intake forms.

● Handle patient complaints and escalate clinical concerns to the appropriate clinician promptly.

● Manage the general practice inbox — triage, prioritise, and respond or escalate as appropriate.

● Maintain accurate, up-to-date patient records in Halaxy in line with our privacy and data handling policies.

● Process incoming referrals and assign to the correct clinician; chase outstanding pathology, imaging, and specialist letters as needed.

Sales Pipeline Administration (remaining days)

● Maintain and update the CRM (Pipedrive) — lead entry, stage tracking, follow-up reminders.

● Send templated outreach and follow-up
s to prospective partners, keeping messaging consistent and on-brand.

● Track pipeline activity and flag stalled deals or overdue follow-ups.

● Pull together simple business insights and reporting — e.g. monthly pipeline summaries, conversion snapshots.

● Keep partner and contact records accurate and current.

Practice Operations Support (remaining days)

● Support provider schedule management — checking availability, gaps, and coverage across the roster.

● Monitor appointment schedules and flag gaps, cancellations, or capacity issues to the operations team.

● Run regular quality checks across practice systems (Halaxy / hubMed Admin Portal) to ensure records, listings, and partner links are accurate and current.

● Identify common patient queries or process friction and suggest FAQ or workflow improvements.

What We're Looking For

Essential

● Minimum 2 years' experience in customer service, virtual assistant, or administrative roles.

● Excellent written English — you'll communicate directly with Australian patients and prospective partners.

● Excellent spoken English — confident and clear on the phone, able to directly resolve patient issues and enquiries in real time, not just via
/chat.

● Hands-on experience using a CRM (ideally Pipedrive, or a comparable system) for lead tracking and pipeline management.

● Some grounding in sales or business development — comfortable with outreach, follow-up cadences, and moving a pipeline forward, even if your prior role wasn't a dedicated sales title.

● Strong attention to detail — patient records, pipeline data, and clinical admin all require accuracy.

● Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional home work environment.

● Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

● Proficiency with standard software —
, Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, video calls.

Highly desirable

● Previous experience in a medical, dental, allied health, or telehealth practice.

● Experience with a practice management system — Halaxy experience is a significant advantage.

● Understanding of Australian healthcare, Medicare, or telehealth services.

● Experience with sales reporting or basic business insights/analytics.

Personal qualities

● Warm, professional, and genuinely patient-focused when in patient-facing mode; structured and detail-driven when in admin/sales mode.

● Proactive — flags problems and suggests solutions rather than waiting to be told.

● Highly organised with the ability to prioritise across genuinely different types of work in the same week.

● Calm and composed under pressure — healthcare admin can be time-sensitive.

● Honest and trustworthy — you'll have access to sensitive patient and business information.

What We Offer

● PHP 45,000–65,000/month depending on experience — at the higher end for candidates with healthcare, Halaxy, or CRM experience.

● Stable, long-term role with a growing Australian telehealth practice.

● Fully remote — work from home.

● Genuine team membership — you are a valued part of hubMed, not a vendor.

● Variety — this role touches patient care, sales, and operations, so no two weeks look identical.

Important — Privacy and Confidentiality

hubMed Telehealth handles sensitive patient health information subject to the Australian Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles. The successful candidate will be required to sign a Confidentiality and Privacy Agreement before commencing work. All patient and business information must be handled with the utmost discretion and in accordance with our data handling policies.

How to Apply

Please apply with:

(Subject line: VA & Sales Admin Application)

We review applications as received. 

● Your current CV including all relevant work history.

● A video introduction.

● A short cover letter (3–5 sentences) explaining why you're a good fit for a role that spans patient support and sales/ops admin — include the word "lighthouse" somewhere in your letter. This isn't a trick; it's a quick, honest check that you've read the full brief, since attention to detail is core to this job. Applications that don't include it will not be shortlisted.

● Your expected monthly rate in PHP.

● A brief description of any experience you have in healthcare admin and/or CRM/sales administration.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video interview. 

A paid trial week will be offered to the final candidate before a formal offer is made.

title: Recruiter
description:
High-Volume Staffing

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–6:00pm Central (1-hour lunch)



Type: Contract / Outsourced (Remote or Hybrid based on location)



Reports to: Recruiting Manager / Agency Leadership

About the Role

We’re looking for an upbeat, professional recruiter who thrives in a fast-paced staffing agency environment. This role is focused on high-volume candidate screening and onboarding support—keeping our pipeline moving, ensuring candidates are qualified, responsive, and ready to start.

You’ll be working alongside our internal team to help deliver a great candidate experience while meeting tight timelines and client needs.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Screen candidates quickly and professionally via phone/video (experience, job fit, pay expectations, availability, reliability)

Review resumes and applications and move qualified candidates through the process with urgency

Conduct reference checks and basic pre-qualification steps (as required per role/client)

Coordinate onboarding tasks including collecting required documents, confirming start details, and ensuring candidates are fully cleared to begin

Maintain accurate candidate notes and status updates in our ATS/CRM and communicate progress to the recruiting team

Schedule interviews and follow-ups and keep candidates engaged to reduce no-shows and drop-off

Support job posting and sourcing efforts as needed (job boards, LinkedIn, referrals, etc.)

Represent our agency professionally—clear communication, strong follow-through, and a positive tone with every candidate interaction

What Success Looks Like

Fast turnaround on screening (same-day whenever possible)

High-quality submissions that match role requirements

Clean onboarding files with minimal back-and-forth

Strong candidate communication that reduces ghosting/no-shows

Consistent activity and pipeline movement throughout the day

Requirements

2+ years of recruiting experience (staffing agency/high-volume preferred)

Confident phone presence and strong screening instincts

Organized, responsive, and comfortable juggling multiple open roles at once

Able to work Central Standard time hours consistently (Mon–Fri, 8am–6pm with 1-hour lunch)

Strong written communication (text/email follow-ups, candidate instructions, status updates)

Comfortable working in an ATS/CRM and keeping detailed notes

title: content coordinator
description:
Job Title: Content Coordination Specialist (SEO)

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Business Unit Lead



About the Role

We are looking for a results-oriented, self-motivated Content Coordination Specialist with a solid understanding of web page SEO on major retailers such as Amazon. The ideal candidate also has image editing abilities and has fluent English copywriting skills. Being able to not only identify opportunities for improvement on our listings, but to also be able to execute those improvements is key.

• Basic proficiency in Photoshop

• Strong analytical and organizational skills with a self-starter mindset.

• Experience with additional retailers such as Amazon, Wayfair, Walmart, Target, Home Depot or others



Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with Amazon A+ Content and Brand Stores.

• Previous experience working with large product catalogs

• Comfort using project and task management tools like Jira

• Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for copywriting, image creation or data analysis

• Familiarity with Pet products

description:
# TikTok Shop Video Editors Needed — Ongoing Work



Creator Toolbox is looking for **TikTok Shop video editors** to join our editing platform.



We have creators constantly submitting new videos that editors can apply to edit, so there will be **ongoing work available**.



### What We're Looking For:



* Experience editing TikTok / TikTok Shop content

* Fast-paced, clean editing with **no unnecessary dead space**

* Able to follow references and instructions closely

* Available multiple hours throughout the day

* Fast and reliable turnaround

* Consistent quality



### Pay:



* **Normal Editing: $1 per video**

title: Freelance Collaborating Counsel & Legal Liaison (Makati Dockets)
description:
Job Title: Freelance Collaborating Counsel & Legal Liaison (Makati Dockets)

Compensation: $600 USD (approx. ₱33,500) flat monthly fee + 100% reimbursement for all government filing fees and out-of-pocket operational costs.

Location Requirement: Metro Manila (Must be able to execute field work in Makati City)



The Objective

I am a US-based client managing a high-stakes, multi-million dollar financial fraud and civil partition case in the Philippines. I currently have a Lead Counsel handling the heavy legal architecture and drafting. I am hiring an independent, licensed attorney to act as my operational boots on the ground.



As my Collaborating Counsel, you will bypass traditional law firm administrative bloat by acting as my direct proxy. Your mission is to physically manage the dockets, execute filings, and ensure government clerks never park or stall my cases.



Scope of Work (The 5-Day Monthly Breakdown)

This retainer strictly covers 5 days of dedicated work per month, structured to respect your time and provide me with consistent operational momentum.



Field Operations & Docket Auditing (4 Days/Month — approx. 1 day per week):

I will deploy you 1 day per week to go to court, look for recent filings, visit various agencies, and speak to personnel on my behalf. You will represent me and must be willing to go wherever directed in Metro Manila for that 1 day a week. Examples include:



Physically visiting the Makati Trial Courts (MeTC or RTC) and Office of the City Prosecutor (OCP) to monitor case status, pull physical folders, and photograph new orders or opponent filings before they are mailed.



Tracking and expediting case raffles to ensure administrative bottlenecks are immediately addressed at the counter.



Retrieving necessary property, tax, or historical records from the Makati City Hall, Assessor's Office, or Registry of Deeds to support ongoing litigation.



Review, Finalization & Affidavits (1 Day/Month):



Review, legally format (margins, jurats, correct legal phrasing), and sign off on basic pleadings or administrative letters that WE will pre-draft. Since I have been in litigation for almost a year now, I have a library of filings, motions, and templates used by my counsel. It is basically plug-and-play now.



Crucial Requirement: You must be willing to testify for me when the time comes. You will basically be my Affiant when you speak to people for me using my Special Power of Attorney (SPA). You will use this 1 day a month to complete your own affidavits regarding your field findings. If you cannot testify in court and be my affiant, do not apply.



Ideal Candidate Profile



Licensed Attorney: Must be an active member of the Philippine Bar in good standing.



Independent/Freelance Practitioner: You must have the autonomy to dedicate one full day a week to my matters. Lawyers currently tied to the grueling schedules of a mid-to-large law firm will not be a good fit.



Street-Smart Operator: You understand that the Philippine justice system does not move on its own. You have the interpersonal skills and assertiveness to deal directly with court clerks, prosecutors, and local agencies to force administrative action. I need someone savvy with an auditor-like attitude. Book nerds and desktop lawyers need not apply—I simply do not have a need for you, and this gig is not for you.



Transparent Communicator: You are comfortable bypassing formal law firm status updates and simply sending direct, real-time photographic evidence of docket logbooks and scanned court orders from your phone.



Personality King or Queen: You must have a pleasant personality and be able to deal with difficult people. You will basically be charming people to move my case, but you must also be the person ready to file an ARTA (Anti-Red Tape Authority) complaint or a disbarment case if someone gives me a hard time or gets out of line.



Why This Role?

This is an ideal anchor client for a young, freelance lawyer building their own practice. It provides a highly competitive, guaranteed monthly flat fee for a strictly time-boxed commitment, leaving you 25 days of the month entirely free to scale your own private client base. There are no 24/7 on-call demands—just focused, weekly execution.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume/CV and a brief message confirming your availability to dedicate 5 days a month to Makati-based field operations.

title: **Fashion Ecommerce Growth Operator | Product Research, Shopify, Meta Ads and Creative Testing**

**Fashion Ecommerce Growth Operator | Product Research, Shopify, Meta Ads and Creative Testing**



## Job Description



We are building a fashion ecommerce operation and looking for someone who can find products with real demand, build high converting Shopify product pages, prepare creative assets, and help scale winning products through Meta ads.



We are looking for someone who understands fashion ecommerce from the customer point of view. The product has to look good, feel aspirational, solve a style or confidence need, and have enough margin to support paid advertising, shipping, exchanges, and returns.



This is not a basic product listing or task based VA role. We need someone who can research, make recommendations, build pages, prepare products for testing, and help us move quickly based on real market signals.



## What success looks like



Within the first few days, you should be able to identify strong fashion product opportunities supported by real demand, competitor activity, customer interest, content potential, and viable economics.



Once a product is approved, you should be able to prepare a polished Shopify page, product offer, bundle or upsell structure, creative references, and launch materials quickly.



The goal is to test products fast, protect margins, learn from the data, and scale the products that show real potential.



## What you will do



1.  Research fashion products across women’s clothing, men’s clothing, activewear, shapewear, accessories, bags, jewelry, travel style, and other high potential categories.

2.  Use multiple research sources to validate products before recommending them. This can include Kalodata, PipiAds,
 Ads Library, TikTok Creative Center, organic TikTok research, Similarweb, Google Trends, Amazon reviews, competitor stores, and fashion trend research.

3.  Identify products that have strong visual appeal, clear customer desire, content potential, healthy margins, and room to compete.

4.  Review competitor offers, pricing, product pages, shipping promises, bundles, reviews, creative angles, and customer language.

5.  Find supplier options and verify product quality, size charts, fabric details, color options, shipping times, inventory reliability, and blind shipping capability.

6.  Build and maintain Shopify product pages with premium images, clear sizing information, style guidance, product benefits, FAQs, reviews, trust elements, bundle offers, cross sells, and mobile friendly layouts.

7.  Prepare original or authorized creative concepts for Meta ads, including UGC style concepts, try on videos, styling videos, outfit ideas, product demonstrations, comparison angles, and customer review angles.

8.  Support Meta campaign setup, creative testing, daily reporting, and product decisions based on CTR, CPM, add to cart rate, checkout rate, cost per purchase, return rate, and ROAS.

9.  Manage product listings, collections, inventory updates, supplier follow up, order issues, customer questions, returns, exchanges, and store upkeep as needed.

10.  Keep all product research, suppliers, sizes, images, videos, creative files, product pages, and testing results organized.



## Fashion product standards



We are not looking for random clothing products.



A product should ideally have:



1.  Strong visual appeal in video and photos

2.  Clear style, confidence, comfort, convenience, or problem solving angle

3.  Existing TikTok or social content with real buyer interest

4.  A reliable supplier with accurate size charts and consistent quality

5.  Enough margin to cover product cost, shipping, ad spend, exchanges, and returns

6.  A strong bundle, cross sell, or repeat purchase opportunity

7.  A product that is not overly common in major retail stores

8.  Low risk of trademark, counterfeit, or intellectual property issues

9.  Clear product details, materials, measurements, and care instructions

10.  A reasonable shipping timeline and easy fulfillment process



## Tools and experience we value



Please tell us which of these you have personally used and what you use them for.



**Research**



Kalodata



PipiAds



 Ads Library



TikTok Creative Center



Organic TikTok research



Similarweb



Google Trends



Amazon reviews



Competitor store analysis



**Shopify and conversion**



Shopify



Shrine



Elixir



Atlas



Kopy



PagePilot



Replo



PageFly



Kaching Bundle



Loop Subscription



Klaviyo



Loox







**Creative production**



Canva



CapCut



Higgsfield



Midjourney



Adobe Firefly



Gemini



Nano Banana



ChatGPT



Claude



**Ads and tracking**



Meta Business Manager



Meta Pixel



Conversions API



Google Tag Manager



Triple Whale



WeTrack



GA4



Shopify Analytics



You do not need to have used every tool listed. We want to understand your real workflow and whether you know how to move fast using current ecommerce tools.



## Trial and communication



This starts with a paid 30 day trial.



During the trial, you must be available from **7 PM to 1 AM CDT** for real time communication, meetings, approvals, and Slack collaboration.



The trial will evaluate your speed, fashion product judgment, store build quality, organization, communication, creative thinking, and ability to support profitable testing.



If the trial goes well, the role can become a long term full time or part time position with performance based incentives.



## How to apply



Start your proposal with:



**FASHION FINDER**



Then tell us how many fashion products you typically review or test before finding one worth moving forward with.



Please include:



1.  One fashion product you personally researched or launched

2.  The research sources or tools you used

3.  Why the product had potential

5.  A Shopify fashion store or product page you built

title: Social Media Manager (advanced experienced required)
description:
# Social Media Manager (Strategy + Execution) | Awakening with Brian



**Location:** Remote. Must overlap 4+ hours daily with US Pacific.

**Type:** [Contractor / Full-time, pick one]

**Compensation:** $1,000 per month, plus performance bonus tied to qualified applications

**Reports to:** Brian Yang, Founder

**Start:** ASAP



---



## Read this part first



This is not a "post 3x a week and send me a dashboard" job. This is for an expert, experienced social media manager.



I run a somatic trauma-healing mentorship. My clients are high-performers who understand their patterns intellectually but cannot change them when they get triggered. The content that works speaks to that gap in raw, specific, body-level language. The content that fails sounds like every other wellness account.



You will not enjoy this role if your heart is not in it, and if you do not resonate with the content, it is truly a transformational and spiritual journey that my work guides people through.



I want someone that is heart-centered and believes in this work. 



I need one person who owns the entire social engine: strategy, calendar, execution, testing, reporting, and the systems that keep it all running without me chasing anyone. You will not be handed a playbook to follow. You will build it, run it, and prove it works with numbers.



I already have a video editor. You are not editing video. You are directing what gets made and why.



---



## What you actually own



**Strategy**

- Own the 90-day content strategy across Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok

- Collaborate with my team, what we make, why we make it, and what each piece is supposed to do in the funnel

- Bring me a point of view. "What do you want me to post?" is not a question I want to answer.



**Planning + project management**

- Build and run the content calendar. Nothing slips. Ever.

- Manage the production pipeline end to end: idea my on-camera shoot list editor caption schedule publish report

- Manage the editor's queue and quality bar. You are the one making sure work comes back on time and on brand.

- Keep me shooting efficiently. Batch my shoot days. Never come to me with a one-video ask.



**Execution**

- Write captions in my voice (we can use help of Claude AI). Short lines. No em dashes. Visceral. Emotionally specific.

- Build simple carousels (Canva or Figma level, clean and text-led, no design degree needed)

- Develop and execute strategy to repurpose/repost content to maximize impact

- Schedule and publish everything, including native posting when trending audio requires it

- Repurpose long-form into short-form and short-form hooks into long-form topics



**Growth systems**

- Manage DM automation, Manychat (need proficiency, doesnt not need complicated or advanced systems)

- Build and maintain the SOP library so this role is documented, not stuck in your head



**Data**

- Own weekly reporting. Not vanity metrics. I want to see: reach, watch time, saves, shares, profile visits, DM triggers, link clicks, applications booked, and where each drops off.

- Run a minimum of 2 structured tests per month. Hypothesis, variable, sample, result, decision.

- Tell me what to kill. That matters more to me than what to double.



**Community**

- Manage comments and DMs after my first-hour window (if possible)

- Escalate anything sensitive to me immediately, using a protocol we build together



---



## You must have



- **3+ years** running social for a brand or creator with real scale, not just your own account, must have experience with big accounts 200k+ following

- **Proof.** Screenshots, dashboards, case studies. Before and after. Numbers I can verify.

- Experience in **coaching, personal development, mental health, therapy, wellness, or online education.** This industry has language rules and ethical lines. You need to already know them.

- **Instagram Reels and DM funnel fluency.** ManyChat or equivalent. You have built keyword flows that converted.

- **YouTube working knowledge:** Not required but would be a bonus to make you stand out

- **Copywriting chops.** You can write a hook that stops a scroll and a caption that does different work than the video.

- **Analytics literacy.** Native platform analytics plus at least one third-party tool. You can read a retention graph and tell me exactly where the script broke.

- **Extreme ownership.** You notice things are broken and fix them before I ask.

- **Ruthless project management.** Notion, Asana, ClickUp, whatever. You keep a system and you keep it current.



---



## Bonus points



- Personal healing work of your own. Therapy, somatic work, men's or women's work, breathwork, plant medicine integration, 12-step. Anything real.

- Experience with Skool, Kajabi, or similar community platforms

- Experience with high-ticket funnels ($7.5k+ offers) and understanding that 10 right people beats 10,000 wrong ones

- Podcast clip distribution experience

- Basic video sense, so you can brief an editor precisely instead of vaguely



---



## This is not for you if



- You need to be told what to do next

- You measure success in followers

- You write in generic wellness language

- You are managing 6 other clients and this is a side slot

- Trauma/spiritual content makes you uncomfortable

---



## Non-negotiables about the work itself



- **Voice discipline.** My brand voice is specific and I do not soften it. You will get a voice guide. You will follow it exactly.

- **Consent standard.** No client story, quote, or clip goes public without documented consent. No exceptions, ever.

- **Sensitivity protocol.** People in my DMs are sometimes in real distress. You will follow an escalation process, not improvise.

- **Compliance.** No copy that implies the viewer has a diagnosis or condition. This is both a platform policy issue and an ethics issue.



---



## What success looks like



**30 days:** You have audited everything, delivered a 90-day strategy, and the calendar is full 2 weeks out at all times.



**60 days:** Production pipeline runs without me managing it. Two tests completed with documented results. Weekly reporting is automatic.



**90 days:** Measurable lift in qualified DM conversations and applications booked from organic. Not reach. Applications.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



**Do not send a generic resume and cover letter. It will be deleted unread.**



Send an
 to 
 with the subject line: **`SME | [Your Name] | [Your favorite piece of content on my account]`**



Include the following. Keep it tight.



### 1. A 3-minute Loom (max)

Talking head, no slides. Answer:

- Who are you and what have you actually grown?

- Watch my last 9 posts. Which one is the strongest and which is the weakest, and why?

- What is the single biggest thing I am getting wrong right now?



If your Loom is over 3 minutes, I stop watching at 3 minutes.



### 2. Written answers (short, no fluff)



1. Name two accounts in the trauma, somatic, or attachment space you think are doing this well, and one specific thing each does that most people miss.

2. In one paragraph: who do you think my ideal client is, and what is the emotional problem they are trying to solve?

3. Describe a test you ran that failed. What was the hypothesis, what happened, and what did you change?

4. Give me one number from your past work that you are proud of, plus the context that makes it meaningful.

5. What are you currently doing for your own inner work? One or two lines. I am not looking for a specific answer, I am looking for whether you have one.

6. What tools do you consider non-negotiable in your stack and why?

7. What is your capacity? How many other clients do you have right now?



### 3. Proof

Links, screenshots, or a portfolio. Analytics screenshots preferred over pretty grids.



---



# PAID TEST PROJECT (shortlist only)



Top candidates get a **paid** 10-hour test project paid on delivery whether or not you get the role.



I pay for test work because I want serious people, and because I want to see how you handle a real brief with a real deadline.



**You will get 72 hours to deliver three things:**



**Part 1: Audit (1 page max)**

Three things working on my Instagram, three things not. For each, name the metric or signal you are reading and the change you would make.



**Part 2: Build**

Take one Reel of mine that underperformed. Turn it into a 7-slide carousel in my voice. Deliver actual designed slides plus the ready-to-post caption. Then tell me in three lines why you think this version performs better.



**Part 3: Plan**

A 7-day content calendar. For each slot: format, topic, hook, funnel job, and the metric you would judge it by. Then propose one experiment for the following month with a clear hypothesis and success threshold.



---



## How I score the test



| Area | Weight | What I'm looking for |

|---|---|---|

| Strategic thinking | 30% | Does the plan connect to revenue, not reach? |

| Voice match | 25% | Does the copy sound like me, or like ChatGPT wearing my clothes? |

| Data reasoning | 20% | Are claims tied to signals, or are they opinions dressed up? |

| Craft + execution | 15% | Is the carousel clean, scannable, and ready to post as-is? |

| Communication | 10% | Tight, clear, on deadline, no hand-holding needed |



---



## Automatic disqualifiers



- Missing the subject line format

- Loom over 3 minutes or no Loom at all

- Copy that reads as unedited AI output

- Any em dash in submitted copy (yes, really, I check)

- Referencing my work in vague terms that show you did not actually watch anything

- Late test delivery with no communication



---



## Final interview questions (for my reference, not the post)



1. Walk me through the last 30 days on an account you ran. What did you d
 and why?

2. I disagree with your strategy. How do you handle that?

3. A post I loved flopped. What do you say to me?

4. A client's DM says something that worries you. Walk me through your next 5 minutes.

5. What would make you quit this job in 6 months?

6. What do you need from me to do your best work?



Listen for: specificity, ownership, comfort with being wrong, and whether they ask questions back.

title: Senior SaaS Website Designer for a Dubai based Design Agency
description:
AT A GLANCE

Role: Website Designer (Figma + Framer). Marketing websites, end to end.

Type: Full-time contractor.

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, Monday to Friday. Minimum 4 hours daily overlap with 10:00-17:00 Dubai time (GST, UTC+4).

Trial: 2-week paid trial on real client work, at the full agreed rate from day one.

Contract: 2-3 months minimum after a successful trial, with extension. For the right person this is a long-term seat.

Rate: state your expected rate when you apply, hourly and monthly.

Reporting: works with Nathan (founder, creative direction) and the studio manager on scheduling and delivery.

Tools: Figma, Framer, Slack, ClickUp.



WHO WE ARE

Anyday is the product design partner for funded startups. Seed to Series B founders in Dubai, the Middle East and the UK pay us a flat monthly fee and get a senior design team on tap. No scoping wars, no per-project haggling, no hiring a $300k Head of Design.



We are small, senior and selective. We take few clients, price confidently, and ship weekly. Our clients stay because the work is good and because working with us is easy.

Recent work: fintech platforms, B2B SaaS dashboards, payments products, AI tools.



THE ROLE

You are the person we hand a website to. Not a piece of one, the whole thing.

A founder needs a marketing site that makes their product look like the category leader and converts the traffic they are paying for. You take that from blank page to live site: structure, wireframes, high-craft UI in Figma, then build it in Framer and hand back something real.



This is a design role, not a development role. We are not hiring an engineer. We are hiring someone whose taste is the reason a site works, who happens to be able to ship it themselves without waiting on a dev.

The bar is craft. Type, spacing, hierarchy, motion, responsiveness. Sites that look like they came from a studio a founder would brag about, not a template with the colours swapped.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Design marketing websites in Figma - sitemap, page structure, wireframes, then polished high-fidelity UI across desktop, tablet and mobile.



Build those sites live in Framer - components, breakpoints, CMS collections, interactions and motion. You ship it, not a handoff file.



Own the site end to end - from the brief and the reference gathering through to launch and the post-launch tweaks.

Work to a brand - some clients arrive with a full identity, some with a logo and a hope. You extend what exists rather than inventing something that fights it.



Design for conversion, not just for looks - hierarchy that sells, copy layout that reads, clear calls to action, fast pages.

Present and defend your work - occasional client calls where you walk through a concept, take feedback live, and explain the reasoning behind a decision.



Work inside our system - daily updates in Slack, tickets in ClickUp, hours logged against a budget. We run tight, not chaotic.



MUST-HAVES



A portfolio of websites you designed - real, live, and good. This is the whole first filter.

Figma expert. Daily tool. Components, auto-layout, responsive thinking, clean files someone else can open.

Framer to a build standard. Not "I have opened it". You can take a design and ship a responsive, CMS-driven site that holds up.

Genuine web design craft - typography, layout systems, spacing discipline, restraint. You can tell us why a site works, not just that you like it.

Strong written and spoken English. You will be in Slack all day and occasionally in front of a client.

Full-time availability and reliable overlap with UAE hours.

Self-starting. You get a brief and references, not a babysitter.



NICE-TO-HAVES

These move you to the top of the pile.

Claude Code, Cursor or similar - you can take a site beyond what Framer allows and build a custom coded page or a full Next.js site with AI assistance. We use Claude Code daily and would rather work with someone who already thinks this way.

Webflow or another visual builder alongside Framer.

Motion design - Framer interactions, scroll animation, micro-interaction polish.

SEO fundamentals - page structure, metadata, performance, Core Web Vitals.

Brand or identity range - you can push a light brand a bit further when a client needs it.

Experience with funded startup or B2B SaaS clients.



HOW TO APPLY

Your portfolio - live links to websites you designed. Tell us which parts were yours if the work was shared.

Which of those you also built, and in what (Framer, Webflow, code).

Your rate and your working hours in UTC.
