title: B2B Cold Caller
description:
About us

Artron BioResearch Inc. develops and manufactures critical components, antibodies, and antigens for immunoassays. Drawing on 20 years of expertise in rapid diagnostic technology, we supply best-matched pairs of monoclonal antibodies and recombinant antigens, ready-to-use lateral flow test components — colloidal gold conjugates, nitrocellulose membranes, sample pads — and semi-finished uncut sheets. We also provide customized R&D services to design, develop, integrate, and validate complete rapid diagnostic test systems.

Our customers are the companies that manufacture rapid tests: IVD manufacturers, diagnostics developers building their own assays, and OEM producers — plus the distributors who serve them. This is technical B2B, not consumer sales.

We're hiring 1–2 cold callers to open conversations with these companies in the US market.

What you'll do

You are not selling and not closing. Your job is to find the right person and start the conversation:

- Call companies on a list we provide and identify the right contact — typically R&D, product development, procurement, or business development

- Get past gatekeepers and reach that person

- Run a short qualifying conversation using the script and guidance we give you: are they developing or manufacturing lateral flow tests, what components do they currently source, who makes the decision, is there a reason to talk now

- Hand qualified leads to our sales team, who take over from there

- Log every call, contact, and outcome in HubSpot

- Clean and improve the list as you go — wrong numbers, people who've left, better contacts

What we provide

- Full training on our products and market — you do not need a science background

- Call scripts, objection-handling guidance, and reference materials

- The target list and HubSpot access

Schedule

- [20 / 30 / 40] hours per week, Monday–Friday

- You need to be live during US business hours: [e.g. 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern = 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Manila]

What we're looking for

Required:

- 2+ years of outbound B2B calling into the US market (BPO or in-house — both fine)

- Clear, neutral English and a confident phone presence; you can hold a real conversation, not read a script

- Proven ability to get past gatekeepers and handle objections live

- Comfortable learning unfamiliar technical vocabulary and using it accurately

- Disciplined CRM note-taking

- Willing to have calls recorded and reviewed for quality

Preferred:

- Experience calling into healthcare, medical devices, laboratories, biotech, or other technical/scientific industries

- Appointment setting or lead qualification experience specifically (not customer service or collections)

- HubSpot experience

Compensation and terms

- $5–$10 per hour depending on your experience and skill level

- Performance bonuses are possible for strong results

- This is an ongoing hourly arrangement, not a fixed-term contract. We want the flexibility to adjust hours in both directions, and you have the same flexibility.

title: AI Fashion Video Creator for Viral TikTok & Meta Ad Formats
description:
## AI Fashion Video Creator for Viral TikTok & Meta Ad Formats



We are a growing US women’s fashion e-commerce brand looking for a highly skilled **AI Fashion Video Creator** who can turn viral fashion-content formats into hyper-realistic, conversion-focused ads featuring our dresses.



This is not a basic video-editing role.



We need someone who can study fashion videos that are already performing strongly on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Meta, understand **why they work**, and create an original version for our brand using our clothing, product images, and approved model assets.



### What you will do



You will receive:



-   Our dress/product images and details

-   Approved model-face or character references

-   A viral fashion-video reference

-   A creative brief or direction



Your job will be to:



-   Research and identify high-performing women’s-fashion video formats on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and similar platforms.

-   Analyze the creative mechanics behind a successful video:

    -   First 1–3 second hook

    -   Opening frame

    -   Outfit reveal

    -   Transitions

    -   Styling sequence

    -   Camera movement

    -   Product close-ups

    -   On-screen text

    -   Pacing, music, and edit rhythm

-   Create **hyper-realistic, original AI video ads** that capture the same *format appeal* using our dresses and approved model assets.

-   Make sure the clothing looks believable: correct color, silhouette, fit, fabric texture, drape, movement, straps, buttons, zippers, and other product details.

-   Maintain consistent model faces, body proportions, styling, and garment details across multiple shots.

-   Turn one viral reference into multiple testable variations for Meta and TikTok.

-   Create ads for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, Stories, and Feed placements.

-   Deliver organized final assets to Google Drive and update our creative-tracking sheet.



### The quality standard



We are looking for content that looks like it was shot for a real fashion brand, not generic AI content or low-quality dropshipping ads.



You must understand how to avoid common AI problems, including:



-   Clothing changing between shots

-   Fake-looking fabric or unnatural garment movement

-   Warped hands, faces, accessories, or body proportions

-   Inconsistent faces/models

-   Flat lighting and cheap-looking product presentation

-   Unnatural motion, flickering, or weak transitions

-   Product details being lost or altered



### Examples of formats you may adapt



-   “Get ready with me” fashion videos

-   Outfit-change transitions

-   Before-and-after styling transformations

-   Occasion-based outfit reveals

-   “Three ways to style this dress”

-   Mirror/selfie-style fashion content

-   Fabric, fit, and detail close-ups

-   Flat-lay-to-model transformations

-   UGC-style try-on content

-   Viral fashion-edit formats adapted into original brand ads



### Required experience



Please apply only if you have:



-   A portfolio showing **AI-generated fashion, apparel, e-commerce, UGC, or product-focused video ads**

-   Strong experience with AI video-generation tools such as Kling, Higgsfield, Runway, Veo, Sora, Seedance, Pika, or similar

-   Experience with AI image/reference tools such as Nano Banana, Midjourney, Seedream, Flux, Gemini, or similar

-   Strong editing ability using CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar

-   A clear workflow for keeping products, garments, and faces consistent in AI-generated content

-   Strong knowledge of TikTok, Reels, and Meta vertical-video creative

-   The ability to work quickly and produce multiple variations from one concept

-   Good written English and reliable communication

-   Availability for consistent, long-term work



### Strong advantage if you have



-   Experience creating women’s-fashion or DTC fashion ads

-   Experience with AI UGC

-   Experience recreating the structure of viral content using original brand assets

-   Experience working with Meta ad creatives or media buyers

-   Examples of work that produced strong engagement, spend, CTR, CPA, ROAS, or other advertising results



### Compensation



**\[Insert compensation, e.g. $1,000/month base retainer + performance bonuses for winning creatives.\]**



This is a remote, long-term role. We want someone who can grow with the brand and become a key part of our creative pipeline.



### How to apply



Start your application with the word:



## VIRALFASHION



Then include:



1.  Your portfolio with at least **5–10 AI video examples** you personally created

2.  Your specific role in each example

3.  The AI and editing tools you used

4.  At least **three examples** of AI fashion, e-commerce, UGC, or product-focused ads you are most proud of

5.  Your realistic weekly output for:

    -   10–30 second vertical ads

    -   Variations of an existing concept

    -   AI videos created from supplied product images and model references

6.  Your usual turnaround time after receiving a brief

7.  Your current compensation and expected monthly rate

8.  Any available ad-performance results or creative-testing experience



### Paid trial



Shortlisted candidates will complete a **paid trial task**.



We will provide:



-   One dress/product image

-   Product details

-   An approved model/face reference

-   One viral-video reference

-   A brief



You will create:



-   One 15–25 second vertical AI fashion ad

-   Two alternative opening hooks

-   One additional variation with a different angle or structure

-   A short explanation of what made the reference format effective and how you adapted it into an original ad for our brand



**No relevant portfolio, no interview.**

Success in this role is measured by how effectively new hires adopt our processes, how quickly they become productive, and how consistently they perform over time.

title: Executive Assistant to Founder (Remote, PH-Based, PST Hours)
description:
Umbrella Property Services is a building services company based in Vancouver. I’m the founder, and I move fast. I think in ideas and loose ends. Your job is to turn that into clear plans, tight calendars, and closed loops. You report directly to me and act as my primary leverage.



This is not a basic VA role. I’m looking for a true Executive Assistant who creates structure around me.



About the Founder & How We Work

- I’m not a micromanager. I’m not looking over your shoulder or nitpicking details. My style is “good enough, ship it, keep moving.”

- I’m chaotic by nature: lots of ideas, lots of moving pieces, and I’d rather be doing deals, strategy, and sales than admin.



Your job is to:

- Put just enough structure around me so my days are sane,

- Protect my calendar so I have real focus time,

- Own the admin and follow-through so I don’t have to chase you or the work.



If you like bringing order to a fast-moving founder and being trusted to run with things, you’ll fit here.



Your Core Outcome

- Give the founder back time, focus, and mental space.

- When I hand you something, you own it until it’s done. I should not have to chase updates, remember details, or manage follow-through. If you need clarity, you ask. If you don’t, you just get it done.



What Success Looks Like in the First 60 Days

- You fully own my calendar: no double bookings, protected focus time, realistic days.

- My inbox is consistently triaged; I only see what actually needs my brain, with drafts ready where appropriate.

- Recurring admin and follow‑ups are handled without me chasing you, and I’m spending noticeably more time on sales, strategy, and deals.



What You’ll Own

1. Calendar & Communication

- Protect and manage my calendar; no double bookings, clear buffers, realistic days.

- Triage inbox and messages; draft replies and summarize what needs my decision.

- Ensure follow-ups and responses don’t fall through the cracks.

2. Follow-Up & Accountability

- Capture commitments from meetings and conversations.

- Turn discussions into clear next actions with owners and deadlines.

- Follow up with internal and external stakeholders and push (respectfully) when things stall.

3. Problem Solving

- Bring solutions, not just problems.

- When something blocks you, come back with: “Here’s what happened, here are options, here’s what I recommend.”

- Ask smart clarifying questions instead of waiting passively.

4. Projects & Operations

- Coordinate small projects and initiatives. This is light operational coordination, not a general operations manager role.

- Prepare agendas, documents, and materials for meetings.

- Maintain simple systems for tasks, SOPs, and follow-ups.

- Improve or automate repetitive admin where possible, including with AI tools.

- Handle personal admin (bookings, reservations, personal tasks) so I can stay focused on high‑value work.



You’ll Succeed Here If You Are

- Highly proactive and self-directed; you don’t wait to be told what to do next.

- Strong at follow-through and holding others accountable.

- Comfortable “managing up” to a busy, idea-driven founder.

- Clear, concise written communicator.

- Calm when priorities change and things are a bit chaotic.

- Detail-oriented and reliable; you take pride in clean work.

- Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning it into structure.

- AI-literate and hungry to keep learning.



This Role Is Not For You If

- You need step-by-step instructions for every task.

- You get stressed by a founder who moves fast and changes priorities.

- You wait to be chased for updates instead of closing the loop yourself.



Non-Negotiables (Read Carefully)

- Based in the Philippines and able to work 7:30 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. PST, Monday–Friday (40 hrs/week).

- Minimum 2 years supporting a founder / CEO / executive as an EA, PA, or similar role.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Comfortable using Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) and Slack for daily communication.

- Quiet, distraction-free workspace (no cafés).

- Reliable computer setup with two monitors (or laptop + external screen), headset, mouse, and keyboard.

- High?speed internet (100 Mbps or faster) for video and calls.



If you do not meet the above, your application will not be considered.



Compensation & Setup

- Fixed retainer of $1,250 USD per month, paid bi-weekly.

- 30 days paid time off per year, aligned with the Canadian calendar (not PH public holidays).

- Bonus opportunities after 3 months, based on reliability, quality, and ownership.

How to Apply

/recruit-ph-ea

s with Ryan

title: COPYWRITER & CONTENT MANAGER — REMOTE
description:
COPYWRITER AND CONTENT MANAGER - REMOTE

Clinic Growth Accelerator (CGA)



---



POSITION OVERVIEW



Company: Clinic Growth Accelerator

Position: Copywriter and Content Manager - Remote

Location: Remote (Must work 9am-5pm CST Monday-Friday)

Employment Type: 1099 Contractor

Compensation: $1,500/month base plus up to $1,000/month performance bonus

Total Year 1 Earnings: $18,000/year (potential $30,000 with full bonus)



---



ABOUT CGA



Clinic Growth Accelerator is a performance marketing agency serving 500+ cash-pay healthcare clinics across the US (chiropractic, dental, med spa, pain management). We generate, produce, and optimize marketing content across
, paid ads, YouTube, and short-form platforms.



We're profitable, fast-growing, and intentionally building a small team of high performers. This is not a traditional agency. We're systems-focused and results-driven.



---



THE ROLE



You are the content production backbone for our copywriting engine. You'll write
s, ad scripts, YouTube scripts, and short-form content on daily deadlines. You own the workflow: from approved briefs to deployment-ready copy, using Claude as your drafting tool to maximize speed and volume.



You are not learning copywriting here. You already know how to write. This is a production system.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (DAILY)



 Writing (10 percent of time)

- Write 7 promotional, educational, and engagement
s per week to our list

- Work from
 briefs, swipe files, and performance data on what's worked

- Each
 is deployment-ready on first draft

- Use Claude to draft, then refine and approve

- Daily target: 1-2
s per day



Ad Script Writing (35 percent of time)

- Write 10-15 ad scripts per week for Meta and
 campaigns (CGA plus clients)

- Short-form, performance-focused, built to convert cold traffic to leads

- Work from positioning docs, avatar profiles, and key messaging

- Every script deployment-ready with hooks, pattern interrupts, urgency, emotional resonance

- Daily target: 2-3 ad scripts per day (45-60 minutes per script with Claude assistance)



YouTube and Short-Form Video Scripts (30 percent of time)

- Write 6 YouTube video scripts per week (CGA brand, Jeff brand, Nick brand from approved concepts)

- Script 20-30 short-form pieces per week (static posts with text, story sequences, short videos with Q and A from approved concepts)

- Work from SOPs on adapting proven content into brand voice

- Use Claude to generate first drafts; your job is to refine, approve, and ship

- Daily target: 4-5 short-form pieces OR 1 YouTube script per day



Content Performance and Strategy (25 percent of time)

- Pull weekly and monthly performance reports on what's converting

- Flag patterns (urgency-based hooks outperforming rational-benefit copy by 40 percent)

- Propose tests using the 1-3-1 framework (identify problem, offer 3 solutions, recommend 1)

- Identify winners and flag what to double down on

- Collaborate with Jeff and Nick on strategy for what's working



---



COMPENSATION STRUCTURE



Base Pay: $1,500/month ($18,000/year)



Performance Bonus: Up to $1,000/month ($12,000/year) when you:

- Hit daily output targets (7
s/week, 10-15 ad scripts/week, 6 YouTube scripts/week, 20-30 short-form pieces/week)

- Maintain quality standards (0-1 revisions per piece due to your error)

- Deliver on time (100 percent deadline compliance)

- Contribute to strategy (flag patterns, propose tests, buy back leadership time)



Potential Year 1 Earnings: $18,000 to $30,000 depending on performance.



---



YOU ARE:



- 2-3+ years of performance copywriting experience (ad copy, short-form, YouTube scripts)

- Proficient in writing performance copy for Meta and
 ads, TikTok, Reels, and YouTube

- Can write quickly without constantly seeking direction

- Think like an operations lead, not a freelancer

- See bottlenecks, organize proactively, document your work

- Communicate clearly (ask questions before writing, summarize work, identify issues)

- Detail-oriented and learn from feedback

- Deliver high-quality copy on tight deadlines

- Have a portfolio of ad scripts,
 campaigns, or short-form copy to show



---



HARD REQUIREMENTS



- 9am-5pm CST every day, Monday-Friday (no flexibility, no exceptions)

- Native or near-native written English (we don't redline, what you submit ships)

- 2-3+ years of performance copywriting in ad copy, short-form, and YouTube scripts

- Proven experience with
 copywriting (bonus if you have open rate or click rate data)

- Comfortable using Claude as a drafting tool and refining from first drafts

- Portfolio with quantifiable performance (CTR, conversion rates, open rates, engagement)

- Proficiency with Google Docs, ClickUp, Slack

- Production-ready from day one (we'll train you on our SOPs and brand voice, not on copywriting basics)



---



PERFORMANCE STANDARDS (HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED)



Output Volume

7
s per week, 10-15 ad scripts per week, 6 YouTube video scripts per week, 20-30 short-form pieces per week



Quality

0-1 revisions per piece due to writer error; proper English, deployment-ready on first draft; scripts hook, convert, and match brand voice



On-Time Delivery

100 percent of deadlines met. No "almost done" or "tomorrow."



Strategic Contribution

Flag performance patterns weekly, propose tests using the 1-3-1 framework, identify winners for scaling



Responsiveness

Revision requests and questions answered same business day



Proactivity

Ask clarifying questions before writing, not after; suggest better angles or messaging



---



THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF:



- You love high-volume, fast-paced writing environments

- You prefer measurable outcomes and clear metrics

- You think systematically about copy, hooks, and what converts

- You take feedback as a brief, not criticism

- You want real autonomy (not hand-holding or micromanagement)

- You're comfortable working 9am-5pm CST with daily stand-ups

- You see writing as an operational discipline, not just an art form

- You're excited about using Claude to draft and refine at 3x speed



---



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



- You need flexible hours or scheduling. This is 9am-5pm CST, no exceptions.

- Your English needs correcting. We don't redline.

- You're learning copywriting on the job (we need proficiency on day one)

- You don't have proven performance copy experience (ads, short-form, YouTube)

- You spend 3-4 hours writing a script when it should take 45-60 minutes

- You need artistic freedom and creative control over every word

- You see revision requests as criticism instead of feedback

- You're uncomfortable with daily output targets and metrics

- You prefer "just writing" without thinking about operations and strategy

- You're intimidated by Claude or refuse to use AI as a drafting tool



---



WHAT YOU GET BEYOND SALARY



Real Impact

Your work goes live daily to thousands of viewers and
 subscribers. High volume, high leverage.



Real Autonomy

You own the entire copywriting workflow from day one. Not a small piece, the whole thing. Direct relationship with leadership (Jeff, the CRO). Decisions move fast.



Real Systems

We obsess over operations and consistency. You'll develop personal workflows, Claude prompts, and processes that compound over time.



Valuable Skills

Master multi-platform copywriting 
, ads, short-form, YouTube), performance metrics, conversion psychology, and high-volume production. These are highly valuable.



Creative Input

Pre-selected concepts plus freedom to suggest hooks, angles, calls-to-action.



Stability

Predictable work, predictable income (no gig economy uncertainty). Monthly payments via invoice.



Transparency

All metrics tracked. You always know if you're performing well and on track for bonus.



Speed of Iteration

Suggest a new hook angle Tuesday, test it Wednesday, scale it Friday (no bureaucracy).



Growth Path

Prove it over 6-12 months and we discuss expanding your responsibility, increasing your scope, or potentially scaling your role. Strong performance opens conversations about what's next, but this remains a contractor relationship.



---



HOW TO APPLY



1. Click the application link below

2. Complete the Typeform questionnaire

3. Record a video application (2 questions, under 5 minutes, genuinely you)

4. We'll review and follow up within 2-3 weeks



Application Link: 
/to/QCrSxfVz



---



COMPANY QUICK FACTS



Company: Clinic Growth Accelerator

Founded: 2019

Team Size: Under 20 (small, intentional)

Clients Served: 500+ healthcare clinics across US

Founders: Nick Urso (COO), Jeff Van Kampen (CRO)

Headquarters: Milwaukee, Wisconsin

Work Mode: 100 percent Remote

Hours: 9am-5pm CST, Monday-Friday (no exceptions)

Employment: 1099 Independent Contractor

Hiring Timeline: 2-3 weeks from application to offer



---



FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS



Can I work different hours?

No. The role requires 9am-5pm CST, Monday-Friday, every day. No exceptions. If your timezone doesn't allow this, do not apply.



Do you provide copywriting training?

No. We need you production-ready on day one. Training on our specific Claude workflows, brand voice, and SOPs is included. Training on copywriting fundamentals is not.



What if I can't hit the daily targets?

We'll discuss it in weekly check-ins. If it's a skill gap, we'll work together. If it's effort or commitment, we'll address it directly.



Is the $1,000 bonus guaranteed?

Only if you consistently hit output targets, maintain quality, meet deadlines, and contribute to strategy. Miss targets, miss bonus.



Can I see sample content or scripts?

Yes. Contact us for examples of the quality level and speed we require. Review them before applying. If you can't match that quality at that speed, this isn't the right role.



Do I need to know Claude?

No prior Claude experience needed, but you need to be comfortable learning it quickly. We'll train you on our specific Claude prompts and workflows.



What's the difference between 1099 and W2?

This is 1099 contract work, which means you're self-employed and handle your own taxes. No benefits. But you have scheduling flexibility (within the 9-5 CST requirement) and can scale earnings with performance bonus.



---



APPLY NOW




/to/QCrSxfVz



We're looking for writers AND operators. If this resonates with you, apply.



No hard feelings if it doesn't.

title: Hiring: Passionate & Professional Video Editor Seeking Creative Freedom
description:
Are you the kind of video editor who understands what makes people stop scrolling?



Do you enjoy turning a good idea into something people actually want to watch, share, and remember?



At ClickCallSell, we're looking for a full-time Video Editor who loves creating engaging short-form content for our internal brand and our home-service marketing clients across the United States.



This position is more than cutting clips and adding captions. We're looking for someone who enjoys storytelling, understands pacing and viewer retention, has a great sense of humor, and takes pride in creating videos that perform.



If you're someone who naturally thinks, "This could be even better..." and enjoys making creative improvements, we'd love to meet you.



What You'll Be Working On

You'll edit a variety of content, including:

Short-form social media videos

Client advertisements

Testimonials

Educational content

Promotional videos

Brand content



Our videos are created for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts.



What Success Looks Like



As a Video Editor at ClickCallSell, you'll:

Create engaging short-form content that encourages viewers to watch, comment, share, and come back for more.

Improve hooks, pacing, captions, sound effects, transitions, and storytelling.

Add B-roll, memes, motion graphics, music, and pattern interrupts where they strengthen the content.

Think creatively and suggest improvements instead of simply following instructions.

Maintain a consistently high level of quality across every project.

Receive feedback professionally, make revisions quickly, and continue improving.

Stay organized and manage projects through 
.



Understanding Our Audience

Although this is a remote position based in the Philippines, our audience is primarily located in the United States.



Because of that, it's important that you're familiar with American humor, internet culture, business communication, slang, trends, and comedic timing.



We're looking for someone who understands what American audiences find funny, relatable, surprising, or worth sharing, not someone who simply follows editing trends without considering the audience.



The Person We're Looking For

Technical editing skills are important, but they're only part of what makes someone successful here.



We're looking for someone who is:

Creative and confident with their ideas

Takes ownership of the final product

Comfortable making decisions independently

Proactive and solution-oriented

Curious and always looking for ways to improve

Coachable and open to direct feedback

Organized, dependable, and consistent

Focused on creating content that performs, not just content that looks polished



We'll always provide footage, scripts, concepts, brand guidelines, and creative direction, but we also value editors who can bring their own ideas to the table.



Required Skills



We're looking for someone with:

Advanced experience using modern video editing software

Motion graphics, sound design, caption animation, and color correction experience

Experience creating content for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts

The ability to source relevant B-roll, graphics, memes, music, and sound effects

Strong English comprehension and communication skills

The ability to work independently while making thoughtful creative decisions

A positive attitude toward feedback and revisions



You'll also receive ongoing education, collaboration, creative resources, and support from our team to help you continue growing.



Why Join ClickCallSell?



This is a long-term opportunity with a team that genuinely enjoys working together.



Many of our Filipino team members have been with us for years, and we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us and become an important part of our creative team.



We work hard, love what we do, and believe in helping both our clients and our teammates succeed.



How to Apply

Please begin your application with the words:

I CREATE VIRAL CONTENT.

Then include the following:

A link to your portfolio (if available)

Your three strongest short-form videos, ranked Good, Better, and Best

Three American creators, brands, or comedy accounts you regularly follow and admire



Applications that don't follow these instructions may not be considered.



Final candidates will complete a paid editing test so we can see your creativity, storytelling, pacing, technical skills, attention to detail, and how you approach improving a concept.



If you enjoy creating videos that people genuinely want to watch and you're excited to be part of a collaborative, creative, and growing team, we'd love to hear from you.



Cheers,

The ClickCallSell Team

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
Lead the creative operation. Then help build what comes next.



Creative Production is the center of this role at the start. You will manage our video editors, own the production system, raise the quality of the work, and move strong creative from brief to final asset without senior leadership having to manage every detail.



This is not a coordinator or virtual-assistant role. We need a proactive Marketing Operations Manager who can operate the day-to-day work and improve the system at the same time.



A note from our CMO



Before applying, watch this short video about the role, its expectations, and what success looks like:




/share/9cd974e7c8a848de8b84a4a992df4e45



About Veritas



Veritas builds complete Starlink Mini deployment setups: mounts, power, cables, cases, and accessories for consumers, work teams, and government fleets. We are a growing U.S. company with a small, high-output marketing team in the Philippines.



Role details



• Full-time independent contractor with fixed monthly compensation of $2,000-$2,500 USD, based on experience, leadership depth, and fit.

• Approximately 45-50 hours per week, fully aligned with Pacific Time.

• Philippine graveyard shift: roughly 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM or 12:00 AM to 9:00 AM, depending on U.S. daylight saving time.

• Fully remote and long-term.

• This must be your only job. No other employment, side hustles, ongoing freelance clients, or subcontracting.

• Occasional weekend availability when production, launches, or publishing require management coverage.

• You must live in Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna. There are no regular onsite office days, but occasional in-person meetings may be scheduled.



What you'll own



At full production, the team aims to deliver one long-form video and up to 14 supporting assets each week for
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.



PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION



• Manage a two-person video-editing team, including their priorities, workload, deadlines, coverage, development, and performance.

• Turn approved priorities into clear production plans, briefs, scripts, storytelling direction, B-roll needs, and deliverables.

• Own the production pipeline: capacity, assignments, dependencies, revisions, blockers, asset readiness, and delivery visibility.

• Review short-form, long-form, ads, thumbnails, static assets, carousels, platform versions, and other creative output.

• Evaluate the full story—not only whether one shot matches one line. Check hooks, pacing, B-roll, demonstrations, captions, CTAs, factual accuracy, brand alignment, and viewer flow.

• Give editors clear, prioritized, actionable feedback and verify that required revisions were completed correctly.

• Use performance findings to identify stronger hooks, packaging, formats, V2/V3 opportunities, and creative tests.

• Build and improve SOPs, review standards, production trackers, asset repositories, AI-assisted QA, and backup coverage.

• Coordinate minor corrections and urgent production support when needed, without turning the role into a primary editing position.



PHASE 2: ADD SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS



Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date, once Phase 1 is operating reliably and you have demonstrated readiness for the expanded scope. At that point, you will also:

• Manage the current Social Media Moderator and future social media team members.

• Own the publishing calendar, content inventory, platform schedules, launch pushes, and publishing verification across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.

• Ensure each platform receives the correct version, copy, CTA, description, tags, products, related content, links, and native-platform setup.

• Oversee community, marketing inboxes, important comments and messages, channel presentation, and routine reputation handling.

• Manage routine creator-partnership and affiliate operations, including communication, records, deliverables, logistics, and escalation.

• Own routine UTM, Bitly, campaign-link, profile-link, and destination-verification workflows.

• Review social performance and turn findings into decisions, tests, and coordinated creative recommendations.

• Build and maintain the social department’s processes, AI workflows, reporting, and continuity systems.



The responsibilities above describe the core scope of the role but are not exhaustive. As Veritas grows, you may also take on related creative-production, social-media, team-management, and marketing-operations responsibilities that are reasonably aligned with the position and approved business priorities.



You're a strong fit if you



• Have at least eight years of professional work experience, including at least three years managing teams and at least two years inside a creative or marketing function.

• Have meaningful corporate, in-house, agency, or field-based operating experience, not only freelance, VA, or task-based remote experience.

• Have managed a creative or video-production pipeline and can lead workload, quality, deadlines, coaching, and accountability.

• Are exceptionally strong at storytelling and can evaluate the complete story and business goal, not only technical editing details.

• Act without waiting for step-by-step direction and continuously improve quality, speed, visibility, and continuity.

• Use performance evidence and AI to improve decisions and execution while checking sources and protecting brand and product accuracy.

• Communicate clearly in conversational American English.

• Can sustain the graveyard schedule and occasional weekend coverage.

• Have reliable primary internet, backup internet, and backup power.

• Want one company to grow with for the long term.



How to apply



Use this subject line and at least 20 AP:

[INSERT REQUIRED WORD] - [X] years of professional experience - [X] years managing teams



Include the following:

• Your resume with company names, employment dates, role titles, team sizes, and whether each role was corporate, in-house, agency, freelance, or VA work.

• Have you directly managed a creative-production or video-production team? Answer Yes or No. If yes, state the team size.

• Can you provide examples of videos, campaigns, or creative projects you directly led if you advance to the next stage? Answer Yes or No. Do not send links or detailed explanations at this stage.

• In one short logistics block, confirm that this would be your only job and that you would complete all work personally. Include your city or province, most recent U.S.-hours role and actual schedule, primary and backup internet, backup power, and occasional weekend availability.



Note: Applications missing any requirement will not be considered.

title: Finance Application Manager – Home Improvement Lending Position Overview
description:
Finance Application Manager / Home Improvement Loan Manager

Unsecured Consumer Financing | Contractor Point-of-Sale Finance | Home Improvement Lending

Role Summary: We are seeking a highly experienced Finance Application Manager / Home Improvement Loan Manager to own the full customer financing process for a home improvement company. This person must be an expert in unsecured consumer financing, contractor/dealer finance portals, loan applications, approvals, stipulations, funding conditions, dealer fees, and sales-team financing support across platforms such as Service Finance, GoodLeap, Aqua Finance, Home Run Financing, Equity Loan Network, GreenSky, EnerBank/Regions, Mosaic, Synchrony, Foundation Finance, PowerPay, and other home improvement financing providers.



POSITION SNAPSHOT



Reports To

Owner, General Manager, VP Sales, or Director of Operations



Employment Type

Full-time; in-office, hybrid, or remote depending on company needs



Primary Focus

Unsecured financing approvals, lender management, funding, sales support, and financing operations



Industry

Home Improvement, Remodeling, Energy Efficiency, Roofing, Solar, HVAC, Windows, Bath, Kitchen



Project Categories

Roofing, solar, HVAC, windows, doors, insulation, exterior paint, bathroom, kitchen, ADU, landscaping, and general remodeling





CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage the complete customer financing workflow from initial credit discussion through application submission, approval, document signing, project completion, funding, and lender follow-up.



Submit, monitor, and manage financing applications through lender portals including Service Finance, GoodLeap, Aqua Finance, Home Run Financing, Equity Loan Network, GreenSky, EnerBank/Regions, Mosaic, Synchrony, Foundation Finance, PowerPay, and other relevant providers.



Match each homeowner with the most suitable financing option based on credit profile, project type, loan amount, approval probability, monthly payment target, promotional product, lender rules, dealer fee, and company margin.



Handle unsecured loan applications, promotional financing, same-as-cash products, deferred-interest plans, fixed APR installment loans, reduced APR plans, and lender-specific home improvement products.



Work directly with lenders to resolve stipulations, identity verification, income or employment verification, homeownership questions, title/property concerns, completion certificates, funding exceptions, and documentation gaps.



Support sales representatives during in-home or virtual sales presentations by explaining payment options, approval paths, lender requirements, financing limitations, and next steps in clear customer-friendly language.



Build and maintain a lender decision matrix that helps the sales team know which lender to use first, second, and third based on project type, credit profile, desired payment, and dealer fee sensitivity.



Track loan approvals, declines, pending applications, funding delays, rehash opportunities, cancellation risks, missing documents, dealer fees, chargebacks, and funded volume.



Coordinate with sales, operations, production, accounting, and customer service to ensure financing paperwork aligns with project contracts, change orders, completion milestones, and lender funding rules.



Maintain lender relationships, program sheets, approval guidelines, rate/dealer fee schedules, portal access, compliance documents, contractor requirements, and training materials.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Minimum 3-5+ years of hands-on experience in home improvement financing, consumer lending, contractor financing, dealer finance, or point-of-sale finance operations.



Direct experience with unsecured home improvement financing is required; experience with secured loans, PACE, home equity, or solar financing is a plus but not a replacement for unsecured lending expertise.



Strong working knowledge of lender platforms such as Service Finance, GoodLeap, Aqua Finance, Home Run Financing, Equity Loan Network, GreenSky, EnerBank/Regions, Mosaic, Synchrony, Foundation Finance, PowerPay, or comparable programs.



Proven ability to improve approval rates, reduce funding delays, lower application fallout, support sales closing, and protect company profitability from excessive dealer fees or incorrect financing product selection.



Understanding of credit tiers, co-applicant strategies where permitted, lender credit boxes, loan amount limits, promotional product rules, dealer fee structures, stipulations, completion documents, and funding conditions.



Experience supporting finance sales for roofing, solar, HVAC, windows, doors, bath, kitchen, insulation, exterior paint, or other remodeling/home performance projects.



SKILLS & COMPETENCIES



Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain financing clearly to homeowners, sales teams, lenders, and internal operations staff.



High attention to detail; able to catch contract mismatches, incorrect lender products, missing signatures, inaccurate loan amounts, funding risks, and compliance issues before they cause delays.



Strong sales-support mindset with the ability to help reps structure payments ethically and effectively without overpromising or misrepresenting loan terms.



Comfortable working in CRMs, lender portals, spreadsheets, pipeline trackers, e-signature platforms, and project management systems.



Ability to build repeatable processes, train sales teams, document lender rules, create scripts, and standardize finance workflows for scale.



Professional judgment, confidentiality, urgency, and a strong understanding of customer trust in financial discussions.



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Application-to-approval rate and approval-to-funded rate.

Average time from application submission to approval and from completion to funding.

Reduction in pending stipulations, missing documents, rework, funding exceptions, and cancelled finance deals.

Funded monthly volume, financed project revenue, and financing-supported close rate.

Dealer fee control, lender mix optimization, and profitability protection.

Sales-team adoption of correct financing process and lender selection guidelines.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Prior role as Finance Manager, Loan Manager, Dealer Finance Manager, Consumer Finance Manager, Sales Finance Manager, or Financing Operations Manager for a home improvement, solar, HVAC, roofing, window, or remodeling company.

Established relationships with lender representatives, underwriters, account managers, or dealer support teams.

Experience creating financing playbooks, lender comparison sheets, sales scripts, monthly payment calculators, approval dashboards, and funding trackers.

Knowledge of compliance expectations around consumer finance disclosures, promotional financing language, adverse action handling, customer consent, data privacy, and fair lending practices.



IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

The ideal candidate is a financing operator who understands both lending and sales. They know how to get customers approved, how to move files through lender portals, how to communicate with homeowners professionally, how to support sales without creating compliance risk, and how to protect company margin while increasing financed revenue. This person should be proactive, organized, lender-savvy, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning the entire finance desk for a fast-moving home improvement business.



RECOMMENDED INTERVIEW SCREENING QUESTIONS

Which home improvement finance platforms have you personally used, and what volume did you manage through each?

Describe your process for choosing between Service Finance, GoodLeap, Aqua, GreenSky/EnerBank, or other lenders for a specific homeowner.

How do you handle a declined application, a conditional approval, or a funding hold?

How do dealer fees affect project pricing and lender selection?

What reports would you build to manage approval rate, funded volume, pending stipulations, and finance fallout?



COMPENSATION STRUCTURE

Recommended structure: competitive base salary plus performance bonus tied to funded volume, approval rate improvement, funding speed, reduced fallout, and sales-team finance adoption. Final compensation should reflect market, experience level, lender expertise, and size of financing pipeline.

title: Excel Operations Specialist
description:
About Self Bill Pro:

Self Bill Pro is a rapidly growing startup dedicated to solving one of the most persistent challenges in the employee benefits ecosystem: the complexity of monthly benefits billing. This role is hands-on and execution-focused, requiring you to work through high-volume, often imperfect datasets to ensure accurate invoicing and reconciliation. You’ll transform raw inputs, identify inconsistencies, and produce reliable outputs that power our billing processes.



While there are established workflows, success in this role requires independent problem-solving and sound judgment when working through unclear or incomplete data.

This is not a traditional business analyst role. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, strong in Excel, and comfortable balancing structured processes with practical, day-to-day data problem solving in a fast-paced environment.

Requirements

Work directly in Excel to manage, clean, and transform data used in billing workflows

Execute data preparation for invoicing and reconciliation across multiple clients

Identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies, inconsistencies, and missing information

Perform detailed data validation and quality checks prior to output delivery

Support plan setup and billing preparation activities for new and existing clients

Work through incomplete or unclear datasets, applying judgment to move work forward accurately

Maintain and update Excel files, templates, and structured datasets

Partner with internal teams to ensure accurate and timely data delivery

Identify recurring data issues and contribute to process improvements



Qualifications:

Advanced Excel proficiency, including complex formulas, lookups, data manipulation, and efficient handling of large datasets

Experience working with large, complex, or high-volume datasets

Proven ability to clean, validate, and transform data from multiple sources

High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and auditability

Ability to identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies and inconsistencies

Comfortable working with incomplete or unclear data, applying judgment to move work forward

Ability to follow structured processes while also adapting when needed

Strong organizational and time management skills in a fast-paced environment

Clear written and verbal communication skills

Required shift of US ET business hours (8pm–5am PHT), with potential transition to a second shift (3pm–12am PHT) following onboarding



Preferred Qualifications:

Experience working in employee benefits, insurance, or HR-related operations

Familiarity with billing, invoicing, or reconciliation workflows

Exposure to process improvement or workflow optimization in a data-heavy environment

Advanced Excel capabilities (e.g., Power Query, dynamic arrays, VBA/scripting)



**Compensation is structured as monthly base pay inclusive of night differential, reflecting the scheduled working hours for this role. Scheduled hours are intended to align with U.S. Eastern Time. The 13th month pay is provided in addition to the stated base compensation in accordance with local requirements. **



Why Join Self Bill Pro:

At Self Bill Pro, you’ll join a collaborative and ambitious team dedicated to transforming outdated processes through smart, scalable technology. If you are a highly motivated individual with a passion for technology and a desire to make a difference in the employee benefits landscape, we encourage you to apply!

title: Moodap | Full-Time Developer – Own the Database & Core Build (Ground Floor Opportunity)
description:
TYPE OF WORK: Any

WAGE/SALARY: $500 weekly to start (Raise after 30 days)

HOURS PER WEEK: 40

DATE UPDATED: Aug 27, 2026



JOB OVERVIEW



Moodap (
) is a live, production mood-based local discovery platform — Next.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, with 37,000+ venue profile pages across 43 Manhattan neighborhoods, a 7-step matching quiz with a custom scoring algorithm, and a fully functional itinerary builder with map integration. This isn't a prototype — it's a live product already indexing on Google, generating organic search traffic, and processing real user sessions daily. This is a remote position.



We need someone to take ownership of the database and core architecture day-to-day: managing and enriching a 37,000+ venue dataset (deduplication, data quality, category/neighborhood coverage), maintaining the scoring/ranking algorithm behind the quiz, fixing bugs as they surface, and building out new features — venue claim flow, business dashboard, sponsored placements — as we scale.



There's real building involved — new pages, new features, structural improvements — but the core of the job is running a live system responsibly: understanding why something broke before touching it, keeping data clean at scale, and not introducing new problems while fixing old ones.



You'll work inside Claude Code, so daily fluency with it is expected — but this is a real engineering role. You need to be able to read our existing codebase, reason about a large-scale multi-table database (venues, neighborhoods, itineraries), and understand what a change actually does before shipping it. We're not looking for someone who prompts an AI tool and pastes the output without understanding it — that approach breaks live systems with real users on them.



You don't need years of experience to apply — the person who built this system out from scratch had none. What you need is real, demonstrable experience: something you can point to and explain, not a resume line. If you can read code, reason about database structure at scale, and ship a fix without breaking something else, that's the bar.



This is Monday–Friday, 40 hours/week, with real ownership and room to grow into a larger role as the platform and team grow. Starting rate below applies to the first 30 days and is reviewed and increased based on performance.



SKILL REQUIREMENT

JavaScript | Next.js | PostgreSQL | Supabase
